variable.name: RESOLUTION
variable.abstract: Factor of extension for coordinates X and Y

description.p: It allows to increase the resolution of coordinates X and Y of process, so it indicates whichever units logics exist by each pixel of screen. For example to advance 400 units in a process with resolution 100 only moves 4 pixels in the screen.

It is recommended to use this variable to slow down the movement of objects that must be moved slowly or to increase the smoothness in complex movements that depend on the precision in mathematical calculations like parabolic shots, gravity, etc.
By default his value is 0, indicating that equivalence is of 1:1
